symptom: Every input widget inside an mxcli-authored list view rendered as `<div class="form-control-static">` — a value, not a field. It reads as a styling bug or a missing entity-access grant and is neither: `show access on entity` reported ReadWrite for the role and `mx check` reported 0 errors (ako/CapTrackV3 FINDINGS §6).
cause: Mendix's List View has an `Editable` property of its OWN (default No), and THAT is what makes the inputs inside it editable — `Editable:` on the individual textbox is a different property and the list view's read-only context wins over it. The parser accepted `Editable: true`, buildListViewV3 never read it, and the writer wrote false. Fixed by `lv.Editable = w.GetBoolProp("Editable")`, plus reading it back in the describe parser so the fix is not undone by the next describe -> exec.
insight: The reporter diagnosed and patched this themselves and asked for it to be upstreamed; the only thing worth adding is where the describe half goes. rawWidget.Editable is a STRING (Always/Never/Conditional) for input widgets, and a list view's is a BOOL. Reusing that one field is what makes the shared output formatter print it — their first attempt added a second emit there and got the property twice. Carry only `true`: false is Mendix's default and an empty value keeps an unchanged list view quiet. The general shape is the one this repo keeps meeting — a property the parser accepts, the builder ignores and the writer defaults, so the model disagrees with the script while every gate is green.
